# Synthetic visual cases

These JPEGs are original, synthetic notebook-style fixtures rendered with Segoe Print on ruled backgrounds. They contain no student data. They exercise image transport with mocked provider outputs, **not model recognition accuracy**.

- `correct-partial`: 3x + 5 = 20, correctly stopped at 3x = 15.
- `incorrect-partial`: 2x + 7 = 19, with an incorrect sign change.
- `calculus-partial`: integration by parts for x cos(x), stopped at the remaining integral.
- `unclear`: deliberately unknown coefficient and right-hand digits; expected clarification instead of an invented solution.

Real vision evaluation and native-device validation have not been performed.
